# Refactor

Run the tests before the first edit and after the last; they pass both times.

## Rules

**Change only what the task asks for.**

Behaviour nobody asked to change stays as it was: the same inputs give the same outputs, the same errors and the same
side effects. When a change has to alter something else, say so before making it.

**Leave every file you touch in better shape than you found it.**

While you change a file, tidy what is cheap and safe to tidy in it: dead code, unused imports, a value written twice,
a name that says less than it should. Keep it in proportion to the change; anything bigger is noted, not done.

Then hand the diff to review.
